hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -q '\.jsx$' && cd /home/user/Hestia && node scripts/build-jsx.js 2>&1 || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -q 'styles\.css' && { CURR=$(grep -oE 'styles\.css\?v=[0-9]+' /home/user/Hestia/docs/index.html | grep -oE '[0-9]+$' | head -1); NEXT=$((CURR + 1)); find /home/user/Hestia/docs -maxdepth 1 -name '*.html' -exec sed -i "s/styles\.css?v=$CURR/styles.css?v=$NEXT/g" {} \;; echo "CSS v$CURR → v$NEXT en $(find /home/user/Hestia/docs -maxdepth 1 -name '*.html' | wc -l) HTMLs"; } || true
